items.title: Charter shares fall 6% in premarket trade as Q3 Internet losses worsen
items.summary: Investing.com -- Charter Communications (NASDAQ:CHTR) shares fell over 6% in premarket trading on Friday after the U.S. cable and broadband provider reported worsening quarterly Internet subscriber losses and a $6.3 billion franchise writedown, and announced a $2 billion cost-cutting plan to try to return to customer growth.

items.title: Charter’s (NASDAQ:CHTR) Q3 2026 sales beat estimates but stock drops
items.summary: Cable, internet and telephone services provider Charter (NASDAQ:CHTR) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with revenue up 9.1% year on year to $14.92 billion. Its GAAP loss of $20.50 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.
